required_client_state.installation_id: Persist a random UUID generated once per installed application instance.
required_client_state.activation_token: Persist only after successful Pro activation; use for validate and deactivate.
required_client_state.entitlement_token: Cache only after successful paid activation or validation; absence always falls back to the application's built-in Free baseline.
required_client_state.verification_keys: Cache the public verification keys returned with successful paid activation or validation.

local_first_policy.free_baseline: Built into MetaTweak and available without network, token, account, key, activation, or verification keys.
local_first_policy.paid_entitlements: Signed platform entitlements add capabilities to the built-in Free baseline.

prohibited_client_dependencies: price, activation-limit, or feature-grant business rules
